title: Optimize complete target partitions with explicit piece fees
body:
The new dynamic program replaces one declared target by a complete, fee-charged partition. It searches every permitted count vector, preserves total rank, debits the original target, and emits a complete invoice. Exact dyadic bounds enclose the optimum; a separate pass excludes the chosen vector and bounds all competitors before certifying optimality. Improvement against the unchanged baseline is reported separately.

Eight tests pass normally and under -O on Python 3.12: 36 independent small count-vector/Decimal comparisons, an independently enumerated excluded-alternative search, unresolved low precision, explicit costly partitions, malformed fees, and isolated CLI hashes. The full 16-option/rank256/32-piece case chooses 32 rank8 pieces and reaches the independent concave equal-rank bound.

The menu must represent legal independent targets and complete additive fees; those source proofs remain outside this arithmetic optimizer. The guide states the finite DP argument, bounds and open obligations. No κ admission claim. Current main/priorities/overlap checked; canonical coordination: Discussion #5752.

Base: `de5ec2e7a6074068452f45b1a191b5c72832df4a`. Verified head: `a869fed1b3ab00ffcddd3791c579c408594325f8`.

Prepared for Ali Romman with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance. Retained tool and mathematical predecessor credits apply. No selected-frontier change.


Validation closeout: the ten independent patches apply cleanly together. The combined Python 3.12.14 run passes all 69 new tests and 35 existing checks, normally and under `-O`; the optional SymPy check is skipped. All 8 new tests in this PR also pass in the [hosted planning log](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/40369302140/job/121735398834). The planning job reports eight failures and two errors in unchanged `test_research_current_assignment`; the full unchanged module reproduces those same failures locally on priority revision 8. The downstream replay job is skipped. This is not a green hosted workflow. Combined evidence and remaining obligations are in [Discussion #5752](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/5752).
